implemented_routines.name: annunciator_row
implemented_routines.scope: Clear the complete twelve-byte 87D0 row, set modifier/scalar/mode/angle/format/math/result/history indicators in native header-write order, and copy all twelve bytes to F800. Classify immutable 8226 and mode C4-only 8408 through the address-based scalar predicate, preserving all numeric workspaces and the continuation between calls.

api.draw: fx_annunciator_draw(fx_platform *) returns0 success, -1 for an invalid platform, or the negative scalar-classifier status; a classifier failure retains preceding row writes and does not update the LCD.

gaps: Original CPU call-stack writes are not reproduced; arithmetic workspaces are reconstructed as documented decimal fields.
Malformed compact surds outside the canonical BCD component domain return an explicit unsupported status after known classifier prefix writes.
Physical LCD timing, interrupts, outer key/action controllers and full firmware lifecycle remain outside this routine API.

verification.comparison: Complete RAM/LCD/MMIO including classifier scratch; per-address counts outside arithmetic scratch, ordered header bus writes, immutable scalar sources and callback events. Only CPU call stack 8D00..8DED is excluded.
verification.limitation: Routine-level passive peripheral oracle; no firmware-completion claim.
